metadata.label: Population per month by region, age and sex. Year 2000M01-2024M12
note: The population of December (as of December 31) is reported according to the division into administrative areas that applied from 1 January of the year following the reference year. The population for the other months is reported according to the division into administrative areas that applied on 1 January and the reference year respectively.
The population refers to the last day of each month.

Statistict for 2025 and onwards are available here: {Population per month by region, age and sex. Year 2025–](https://www.statistikdatabasen.scb.se/pxweb/sv/ssd/START__BE__BE0101__BE0101A/BefolkManadCKM/)

0186: Since 1 January 2011, Liding municipality has expanded with a part of Vaxholm municipality. This means that 154 persons is changing municipality belonging. Please note that the figures for the municipality are not comparable with earlier figures.
0187: Since 1 January 2011, a part of Vaxholm municipality has been transferred to Lidingö municipality. This means that 154 persons is changing municipality belonging. Please note that the figures for the municipality are not comparable with earlier figures.
03: Since 1 January 2007, Uppsala county has been expanded to include Heby municipality. Please note that the figures for the county are not comparable with earlier figures.
0330: Since January 1 2003, a new regional division has been established. Parts of Uppsala municipality (0380)  have formed a new municipality called Knivsta (0330).
0331: Since 1 January 2007, Heby municipality has been transferred from Västmanland county to Uppsala county. The code for Heby has changed from 1917 to 0331.
0380: Since January 1 2003, a new regional division has been established. Parts of Uppsala municipality (0380)  have formed a new municipality called Knivsta (0330).
19: Since 1 January 2007, Västmanland county no longer includes Heby municipality. Please note that the figures for the county are not comparable with earlier figures.

Alder.label: age
note: Age refers to age attained by the end of the year, i.e. in principal, an account for the year of birth.
